hooks.command: if command -v kavachkit >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec kavachkit guard; else echo 'kavachkit is not installed, so this action was blocked to keep you safe. Install it with: cargo install kavachkit' >&2; exit 2; fi
if command -v kavachkit >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec kavachkit warn; fi
if command -v kavachkit >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec kavachkit memory-save; fi
if command -v kavachkit >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec kavachkit memory-load; fi
